title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Hero's Missing Cape
moral: Being brave and helping others makes you a true hero.

pages.content: {{NAME}} flew into Hero City. The city was full of tall buildings and bright lights. Animals lived in every window. A big friendly robot stood in the town square. The robot looked very sad. His shiny gold cape was gone.
